functions.name: CleanupBakedDataIfNeeded
functions.note: (probe type 0 reverb / 1 pathing / 2 custom data, custom data type, context): the rebake option from steamaudio vf 0x138 / 0x140 / 0x148; Manual (1) logged as deprecated and taken as Cleanup; Cleanup drops the baked file from the outputs (context vf 0x1a0 with 180107ca0) and returns true (no bake); Auto (2) returns false. Inlined in the four other builders that hold its lambda

functions.name: CleanupBakedDataIfNeeded_lambda
functions.note: the predicate: an output path with its slashes made '\', strstr for the baked file's name; true when it is not that file
